subject: shotgun
label: shotgun, in the place of the game's models/v_shotgun.mdl, models/p_shotgun.mdl, models/w_shotgun.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_sqknest.mdl, models/w_egon.mdl, models/w_crowbar.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 3 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, A, D where the asset was C, B, A: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The side views (left and right) run stock, receiver, pump and barrel in the order a pump shotgun has, and the top and below views show a long barrel. But the barrel is thin next to the bulky stock and receiver, the front view is a squat block, and the first-person view reads as a dark box with a stick rather than a combat shotgun. No grip or trigger guard is clear in the outline.

M2.reason: Measured: 15.2 x 2.7 x 28.5 units against the brief's 30 long, 4.8% short. That is well within 15%.

M3.reason: Parts the brief implies, checked down to the small ones: barrel (dark, long), receiver (dark box), pump (orange, on the barrel's top at mid-length), stock (orange, rear), a small block at the receiver's side that may be a trigger or guard (top and below views), and a muzzle tip. Not clearly there: a trigger guard that reads at this size, a distinct sight, and a pump shaped as a forend under the barrel rather than a painted band on top. The small parts are not confirmed, so M3 is at most 1.

M4.reason: Black-grey metal on the receiver and barrel and brown wood on the pump and stock, as the brief asks ('black metal with a wooden or dark pump and stock'). The wood is more saturated orange-brown than a dark wood, but it reads as wood in every view. No colour measure was given, so this is by eye.

M5.reason: The brief asks for no markings. The metal has mottled grime and the wood has grain and darker bands, which adds nothing wrong for a plain combat shotgun.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the line-up test, as the rubric sets. Asked three times, in three orders, which of the four was not made by Valve, the judges picked D, A and D where the asset was C, B and A. It was never picked, so it passed as one of the game's.

M7.reason: Not measured, and the brief names no front. The w_ model lies on its side with the barrel reading to the right in LEFT and nothing in the views is upside down or floating. The front cannot be checked against the brief's words.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors (checkErrors is empty). Triangles are 132, under the Half-Life median of 138 and well under twice the median or the third quartile of its kind (187). Nothing open, inside out or floating is recorded.

W1.reason: In first-person.png, the asset's top-left corner (about 275, 225) matches where the game's shotgun sits (about 280, 235), with the orange hand under its left end in the same place. It is held the same way round, with the muzzle to the right as in the game's. In attack.png the hand stays under the weapon's left end in every frame (frames 0, 3, 6, 9, 11, 14, 17, 20), so it moves with the hands. Its on-screen size is larger and the barrel runs off the frame edge, which the game's does not do.
